tweets.text:
We built an AI agent that personalizes every website visit.

It connects to your Google Analytics and Google Ads account.

It then creates personalized pages for every referring page and ad keyword. It keeps iterating with A/B tests until it finds the copy that resonates most.

As a result, it improves your website traffic conversions.

Why did we build this?

Every visitor to your website is unique; a person arriving from a Google Ad targeting competitors is different from someone coming from a news article. Creating a unique copy for each traffic source and iterating thousands of times would've been impossible.

An AI agent can work continuously, running thousands of small feedback loops over days until it finds the traffic that converts most.

(Link to try on my profile—we have a waitlist and a launch day promo…)

Just look at the chart below based on the latest numbers Google released.

Even with 13 billion searches a day, they control only 27% of the search market share.

People genuinely use multiple platforms to perform a search. Just like people use multiple social media platforms.

This doesn’t mean you should ignore Google, it’s an amazing channel.

It just means you should focus on ALL the channels your customers use.

The new SEO is Search Everywhere Optimization.
